title: Public Voice Between Elections
subtitle: A discussion pack for civic and activist groups in India
tagline: 100 public-interest issues • practical routes for participation • existing organisations and remote contributions
purpose: Prepared for discussion, correction and possible collaboration
disclaimer: This is a proposal, not an endorsed movement platform. No organisation listed here has agreed to participate. The specific movement or coalition has not been identified; affiliations are therefore not asserted.
workingContext: Working context: this pack adapts the India Public-Interest Agenda 100 v0.1 and the portable-voting rights specification from this conversation. It does not claim legal certification, existing institutional adoption or endorsement by any listed organisation.
aiAssistedNotice: AI-assisted preparation. Check substantive claims, legal routes, translations and participant consent before adopting the text as a movement statement. Corrections and disagreement are welcome.

A.title: The 100 public-interest issue families
A.intro: Each card names examples of who can raise it, an indicative owner, possible lawful changes, evidence to collect and conditional refusal routes. Owners require current state/sector validation. No evidence listed below is asserted to have already been collected.
